rationale: Round 12 exhaustively proved B128 without TMA is broken for K_step=16 BF16. TMA required. deep_gemm confirms TMA+B128+make_smem_desc(ptr,1,0,1024) works. Use rs-form to avoid A-descriptor complexity.

implementation_spec.approach: TMA+WGMMA rs-form flash attention on H800 SM90a

smem_layout.Q_smem: TQ=64 x HD=64 BF16, cp.async linear
smem_layout.K_smem: TKV=64 x HD=64 BF16, TMA B128 (transB=1 for QK WGMMA)
smem_layout.V_smem: TKV=64 x HD=64 BF16, TMA B128 (transB=0 for AV WGMMA)
smem_layout.S_smem: TQ=64 x TKV=64 BF16, thread-written linear
smem_layout.mbarrier: 2x uint64_t for K and V TMA sync

tma_descriptor_creation.note: Same TMA descriptor shape for K and V

wgmma_descriptor.k_advance: desc.reg32_[0] += 2 per k-step (32 bytes = 1 TMA-B128 K-group width)

loop_structure: thread0: issue TMA load K (with mbarrier_k)
thread0: issue TMA load V (with mbarrier_v)
wgmma.fence; QK rs-form x4 k-steps; wgmma.commit; wgmma.wait
scale + mask + online softmax (same as WMMA version)
wgmma.fence; AV rs-form x4 k-steps; wgmma.commit; wgmma.wait

mbarrier_ptx.wait: loop: mbarrier.try_wait.parity.b64 P, [addr], phase; @!P bra LOOP

setup_py_changes.libraries: Add 'cuda' to link with libcuda.so for cuTensorMapEncodeTiled

implementation_spec.acceptance: correctness PASS (test.py all N values) + latency < 0.38ms

dead_paths_do_not_retry: B128 ANY manual swizzle formula without TMA - broken for K_step=16 BF16
transB=0/1 manual smem store for WGMMA B
ss-form WGMMA with manually-written A smem
